name: ZSO_SHARE_DOC_SIGNAL_SCORES
description: This table is used to collect different categories of Scores for Share Documents, which may be sourced through counts, aggregations, analytic analysis or third-party plugins.

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_SIGNAL_SCORES_ID
columns.description: ID column: the uniquely identifying surrogate key value.

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_ID
columns.description: The Share Document for the signal score.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SCORE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Signal category for which the score is calculated.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SCORE
columns.description: Score for the given signal category - in order to support the possibility of scores that are floating point as well as integers, the column is defined with no precision and no scale.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_REVISION
columns.description: Revision of the document that generated this signal.

columns.name: PAGE_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Page sequence number that generated the signal if the signal was generated from a 'slide' vs. a 'presentation'.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SUBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates what type of fusion entity is associated with this signal.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: 'polymorphic' fk id for fusion entity associated with the signal score.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Optional value to allow aggregation of personalized Score values for individual users.
